title: Verdigris Sting
description: A high-register acid bass-lead: a single resonant sawtooth squelches through a ladder filter envelope while euclidean stabs and a synced tremolo chop it into a rhythmic gate. Over 16 cycles the filter sweep, resonance and crush all drift, melting from a clean metallic ping into a corroded screaming acid line.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<c3 [c3 eb3] g3 <bb3 f3>>(<5 7 5 3>/2,8)").s("sawtooth")
    .lpf(sine.slow(16).range(400, 4200)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(12, 22)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<5 7 9 6>/4").lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.11).lpsustain(0.2)
    .penv("<0 7 0 -3>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.05)
    .tremolosync("<2 4 8 4>/8").tremolodepth(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 0.85))
    .crush("<16 10 7 8>/8").shape(sine.slow(24).range(0.2, 0.5)).distort(0.3)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.18).sustain(0.45).release(0.05)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).crush(6).pan(0.85))
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.55").room(0.2).gain(0.9)
)
